install_note: The engine itself is pure Python 3.12 stdlib with zero pip dependencies. yt-dlp powers the YouTube source and the gh CLI powers the GitHub source; without them those two sources simply report off in --diagnose and the other three still work. gh also needs 'gh auth login' once. Optional API keys for X, TikTok, Instagram and Bluesky go in ~/.config/last30days/.env (chmod 600), never in the repo.
